sloka: एवम् विलपमानस्य दुह्ख आर्तस्य महात्मनः ।मोहाच् च शोक सम्रोधात् बभूव लुलितम् मनः ॥२-७५-६४॥
transliteration: evam vilapamānasya duhkha ārtasya mahātmanaḥ ।mohāc ca śoka samrodhāt babhūva lulitam manaḥ ॥2-75-64॥

translations.english: Afflicted by sorrow and lamenting thus, great Bharata's mind became unsteady owing to swooning and besieged by grief.
